title: Microsoft releases updates fixing 1,400+ security vulnerabilities, surpassing September's record of 972, which was already ~10x the normal monthly patch load (Brian Krebs/Krebs on Security)
summary: Brian Krebs / Krebs on Security: Microsoft releases updates fixing 1,400+ security vulnerabilities, surpassing September's record of 972, which was already ~10x the normal monthly patch load — Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software.
